acceptanceCriteria: The root cause is confirmed with evidence: either a Git child process or Git auto-maintenance/gc started by a fixture outlives the test, or the early aggregate-admitted-limit error path in ProduceAggregateOutcome leaves an unawaited subprocess.
`GOTOOLCHAIN=local go test -count=20 -run TestAggregateOutcomeNativeAdmissionSizes ./internal/tracerecordrepo/` passes repeatedly under concurrent host load.

If the cause is a product subprocess leak, a regression test proves that no Git child outlives ProduceAggregateOutcome on the limit path. If the cause is fixture-only, the fixture Git commands disable auto-maintenance and gc (for example -c maintenance.auto=false -c gc.auto=0) and the fix is named in the related V1-0662 class.
body:
Suspected defect, root cause unconfirmed. Reported 2026-10-05 by the pstack-claude agent optimization session. Related to V1-0662 (affected fixtures launching detached Git writers in internal/liveverify/affected) but distinct: a different package and fixture.

Reproduction: clean detached worktree at origin/main 8a35775a; Go 1.27.1 darwin/arm64; Apple Git 2.54.0 with no global maintenance.auto or gc.auto set; TMPDIR=/private/tmp/claude-501/td. Running `GOTOOLCHAIN=local go test -count=5 -run TestAggregateOutcomeNativeAdmissionSizes ./internal/tracerecordrepo/` failed 2 of 5 runs. It also failed 1 of 3 on the V1-0750/0751/0325 batch branch, and once inside `make gate` (ledger/go-test) on batch head c0a8b4ba, which does not touch internal/tracerecordrepo.

Actual: the behaviour assertions pass, then `testing.go:1617: TempDir RemoveAll cleanup: unlinkat <td>/TestAggregateOutcomeNativeAdmissionSizes513.../001/.git: directory not empty` (variants: .git/info, .git/objects). Expected: the fixture repository is removable at test end, and no Git writer outlives the test.

Clue: only the 513 subtest fails (299 and 512 do not). 513 is the case where ProduceAggregateOutcome returns the aggregate-admitted-limit error early (internal/tracerecordrepo/aggregate_outcome.go:140, via aggregatePathsValid).

Hypotheses (unconfirmed):
(1) A fixture `git commit` with about 520 new objects triggers auto-maintenance or gc that outlives the test. The fixture helper gitAdapterFixture (adapter_test.go:136) does not pass -c maintenance.auto=false -c gc.auto=0.
(2) The early-error path leaves an unawaited subprocess.
title: tests (suspected): TestAggregateOutcomeNativeAdmissionSizes/513 intermittently fails TempDir RemoveAll cleanup (.git not empty)
